title: ML and AI Foundations: From Data to Deployed Model
description: A hands-on path from data and metrics through neural networks, LLMs, and production evaluation.
prerequisites: Python Foundations or equivalent Python experience.
assessment: Complete three experiments and a documented model evaluation.

lessons.title: Data, Features, and Labels
lessons.objective: Build a clean dataset and identify leakage risks.

lessons.title: Classification and Metrics
lessons.objective: Compare accuracy, precision, recall, and threshold tradeoffs.

lessons.title: Generalization and Overfitting
lessons.objective: Design an experiment that exposes overfitting.

lessons.title: Neural Networks
lessons.objective: Train a small neural network and inspect its learning curve.

lessons.title: Embeddings and Similarity
lessons.objective: Use vectors to retrieve semantically related records.

lessons.title: Tokens and Language Models
lessons.objective: Trace text through tokenization and next-token prediction.

lessons.title: LLM Evaluation and Failure Analysis
lessons.objective: Build a labeled evaluation set and report uncertainty.

lessons.title: Production ML Systems
lessons.objective: Package inference, monitoring, tests, and rollback evidence.

lessons.title: Capstone: Evaluated Local Model
lessons.objective: Ship a local model experiment with reproducible metrics and limitations.
